title: Simple, cost effective, and has magnets on it to store on stove or frig
text: Simple, cost effective, and has magnets on it to store on stove or frig. As described. Have been using this for two months. Appears very accurate so far. Might be tricky for someone with poor dexterity or large finger tips as you have to depress a button to release the probe.

product_metadata.title: ThermoPro Digital Meat Thermometer for Cooking Instant Read Food Thermometer with Probe and Backlight for Oil Deep Fry Smoker BBQ Grill Kitchen Candy
features: Super-fast: Instant read meat thermometer with backlight features 3.9 inches food grade temperature probe, gets temp readout in 3-5 seconds with high precision sensor

Accurate readout: Digital food thermometer with temp range of -58 ~ 572 degree Fahrenheit (-50 ~ 300 degree Celsius); accurate to ±0.9 degree Fahrenheit; Perfect for indoor outdoor cooking, grilling, BBQ and so on
Easy to use: Grill thermometer with foldable probe design, folds away easily and locks into base for portability; Magnetic back and hook allows for convenient storage
Smart design: Probe thermometer will auto shut off if readout stays on for 10 minutes; Powered by AAA battery which included in package
Backlight display: Digital cooking thermometer features backlight LCD display to let you see clearly while cooking in the evening, indoors or outdoors
